name: @sverse/contracts
description: Sverse smart contracts for Avalanche C-Chain

scripts.export:abi: hardhat compile && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),os=require('os'),path=require('path');const names=['MockSRV','SverseItems','SverseDeedRegistry','SverseStore','SverseMarketplace','SverseRewards'];const out=path.resolve('../backend-v2/src/adapters/chain/abi');fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});for(const n of names){const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join('artifacts/contracts',n+'.sol',n+'.json'),'utf8'));fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,n+'.json'),JSON.stringify({contractName:n,abi:a.abi},null,2).replace(/\n/g,os.EOL)+os.EOL);}"
